manual_review.area: Private request scope and early binding
manual_review.conclusion: The Connection extension is cloned before the request is moved, and task-local scope wraps next.run INSIDE the future retained by requests.run_async. Response.start and BODY.prepare_checked bind their weak-self cancellation callback before actual producer/spool I/O, then retain Lease in their existing owned Control/Slot. This does not require task-local propagation into spawn_blocking. No handler signature or DTO changes are introduced.

Registry worker/supervisor/body ownership remains original. Each Lease owns its callback; callback captures only Weak Control/Slot and connection map holds Weak callback, avoiding a strong cycle. Response finish_body removes its lease after terminal state publication; BODY slot holds its lease through existing slot/body lifetime. The referenced Connection API releases its binding mutex before callbacks, so the added terminal Lease drop does not create an observed mutex cycle. The callback API implementation itself is under the other reviewer.

BODY close_admission becomes gate-only, matching response close. Both explicit cancel_all operations only publish their original cancellation signals and leave actual joins to existing owners. The server passes both into the new transport deadline callback. The old BODY cancellation test explicitly requests abort after gate close and otherwise retains its entire original assertions. This is the authorized behavior change needed for positive responses during inbound grace, not a claim that all standalone registry drains self-timeout.

close_admission records T0 once per call, synchronously closes global admission and response admission, invokes transports.quiesce_at(t0), then closes BODY/CSV/read/file admissions before awaiting pause/drain. The transport contract preserves the earliest phase deadline; repeating close may not extend it. All eight previous drains plus transport drain are awaited concurrently and all errors collected. The coordinator/deadline remains independently owned while pause_active or any held outbound/verified worker waits. No whole-application five-second bound follows.

Transport registration precedes readiness. Success joins serving and lifecycle drain concurrently; transport sticky failure is a shutdown trigger, then serving/drain/owned-stdin-monitor errors are all collected before receipt. Startup refusal drops readiness, closes admission and runs every old drain before the same retained monitor/final error path. New transport actual-handle internals remain the other reviewer's slice. Whole serve-future abandonment remains explicitly outside this proposal's complete-drain claim.

Only the already locked hyper-util0.1.21 becomes a direct dependency with default features false and server/http1/service/tokio. Exact inverse proves Cargo.lock changes solely its App dependency edge; package versions/set remain exact and h2 absent. Cached primary-source gates support the planned interface but actual Cargo feature/type compilation is NOT_RUN. Router/host-origin layers, four local HTTP1.0 refusals, policy/resource formats, Store/64MiB/8MiB/spool limits, MCP/Core/crawl/PDF/outbound/renderer and public schemas stay outside the modified logic or exact critical regions.

Parent is the immutable UNFORMATTED Source6 compositionbc573, not an accepted Source6 release. The separate Core guard correction ef8ce9 is outside these seven paths. Actual corrected/formatted/frozen Source6 rebase plus independent merge/formatter review, compiler/Clippy/full inherited suite and genuine native process/pipe/TCP/body acceptance are still mandatory. No old Source5/6 PASS or authored TCP test is counted as execution.
